gunner_front.prompt:

Subject: a "feral gunner droid" from a desert colony world: a 2.0 m tall, lean, upright, humanoid-proportioned former security/survey robot that has gone feral after years in the desert scrub. Design details: narrow angular armoured sensor head with ONE large round amber-red glowing optic lens in the face; slim neck with cable bundles; faded olive-drab and slate-grey armour panels on chest, shoulders, thighs and shins over a dark gunmetal frame; exposed pistons and hydraulic lines at the elbows, knees and waist; a salvaged long-barrelled rivet/arc gun built onto the robot's own RIGHT forearm (this appears on the VIEWER'S LEFT in this front view): a chunky receiver strapped and bolted along the forearm, with a long ribbed barrel extending well past the hand, copper coil rings and a cable running up to a small power cell on the upper back; the right hand is a compact three-fingered clamp under the gun; the LEFT hand is a normal three-fingered steel manipulator; a thin sensor mast / whip antenna on the left shoulder; mismatched welded patch plates; sun-faded chipped paint, rust at seams, bolts and edges, sand grime on feet, shins and joints, wear on edges and handles.

Style: realistic hard-surface sci-fi, photoreal PBR materials, grounded industrial design. NOT cartoon, NOT toy, NOT low-poly, NOT chibi. No text, no numbers, no logos, no insignia, no decals with lettering. No base, no ground plane, no props.
